args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and extra batteries/memory cards
- Travel insurance information

Clothing:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and sightseeing
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Beach Day (Waikiki Beach - June 11):
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear (or plan to rent)

Snorkeling (Hanauma Bay - June 12):
- Rash guard or UV protective shirt
- Water shoes
- Underwater camera (optional)

Hiking (Diamond Head - June 13):
- Sturdy hiking shoes
- Hiking socks
- Backpack with water
- Sunscreen (reef-safe)
- Insect repellent

Pearl Harbor Visit (June 14):
- Respectful attire (covered shoulders and knees recommended)

North Shore Road Trip (June 15):
- Cooler for drinks and snacks
- Extra layers for potential wind/rain

Luau Experience (June 16):
- Hawaiian shirt or floral dress (optional but fun!)
- Comfortable clothes for sitting

Spa Day (June 17):
- Spa-appropriate attire
- Swimsuit for pool/hot tub

Kayaking (Kailua Beach - June 18):
- Quick-dry clothing
- Waterproof bag for valuables

Shopping (Ala Moana Center - June 19):
- Reusable shopping bags
- Comfortable walking shoes

Health & Safety:
- Prescription medications
- First aid kit
- Motion sickness medication (if needed)
- Hand sanitizer
- Face masks (as needed)

Toiletries:
- Reef-safe sunscreen (minimum SPF 30)
- Aloe vera gel (for sunburns)
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb

Electronics:
- Universal power adapter (if needed)
- Portable power bank
- Headphones
- E-reader or books

Miscellaneous:
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for day trips
- Small backpack/day bag
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes
- Travel pillow for flights
